confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Phuket price levels; no live menus, booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by area, season and booking date; room anchors assume a July low-season window. Cocktail and wine_glass were not directly known, so they were set from the beer anchor using typical local bar and restaurant multiples (about 2.3x and 2.5x).
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Thailand's other southern beach-resort destinations (such as Krabi and Koh Samui) and general Thai restaurant price levels.
